summary: Iteration 16 work (copilot app controls). I tested the backend through the public URL: 22 new /api/agent control tests plus 6 unit tests, 28 of 28 passing on two runs with no flaky tests. Frontend testing used Playwright at 375x667 across two full sessions. Every requested flow works. 'Take me to Reno' shows a route card with the Go button. 'Okay, let's go. Can you start the ride?' starts driving mode (nav-banner shown); the original 'didn't catch that' bug is fixed. 'Mute/unmute the directions' updates the voice-guidance-toggle label. 'My truck is 13 foot 2 and 70000 pounds' changes the chip to 13'2" · 53' · 70k lb and triggers a reroute (POST /api/route 200 in the logs). Hazmat adds the truck-hazmat-badge. 'Show me the other options' opens the options list. Zoom in/out, recenter, overview, 'be quiet' and 'end the route' (back to 'Where to next?') all work. Every turn showed a real reply in agent-reply-text and none said 'didn't catch that'. Two minor issues: replies can end in '?.', and 'show the whole route' during driving leaves navigation mode. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: Double punctuation in the reply. controls.py:148 runs rstrip('.') and then adds '.', so sentences ending in '?' come out as '?.'. Seen in the UI: "There's no route yet. Where do you want to go?." Fix: only add '.' when the sentence doesn't already end in . ! or ?.

If the model returns a value with units (e.g. '158 inches', '13 ft 2'), _int() returns None. The action is then silently dropped, and if it was the only action the driver hears 'didn't catch that'. Not seen in testing because the model returned plain numbers, but it is a robustness gap.

integration_issues.issue: The 'overview' action calls setDriving(false) (index.tsx:610). Saying 'show the whole route' during navigation exits driving mode: the nav-banner and turn directions disappear and the Go card comes back, so the driver has to say 'let's go' again. Probably unexpected for a hands-free driver. Consider fitting the bounds while staying in driving mode, or returning to driving automatically.

reroute() (index.tsx:579) throws away the new route if another turn started before /api/route answered (myTurn !== turn.current). The profile is saved, but the route on screen can keep the old geometry until the next route request. Minor race condition.

issues: The caption bubble sits on top of the TopBar and demo-location area at the top while the options sheet is tall, which leaves very little map visible. Cosmetic.

action_items: controls.py:148: stop adding '.' after sentences that already end in '?' or '!' (fixes the '?.' reply).
Decide on 'overview' while driving: right now it ends navigation mode (index.tsx:610). Keep driving mode and only fit the map bounds, or say so to the driver.
Optional: make controls._int parse values with units (e.g. take the first number) so actions aren't silently dropped.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is 793 lines (over 700). Consider moving runActions/reroute/clearRoute into a hook such as useCopilotActions.
Frontend add_favorite_chain does not de-duplicate on its own and relies on the backend check against truck_profile.favorite_chains. Fine because the app sends getTruckProfile().
The wake_word toggle could not be checked visually: wake-indicator only renders when wake.supported, and it is not supported in headless web. The backend action and setHandsFree call are correct.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (7/7), plus extra controls checked

seed_data_creation: None. The truck profile lives in the browser's local storage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the Type button (type-button), then copilot-text-input and copilot-send-button. The reply text is in agent-reply-text; avatar-caption is only the avatar label ('Talk to copilot'). Skip onboarding by clicking 'Skip' up to 4 times. LLM answers come back in about 1-3 s. Places are MOCKED (Sacramento demo places).
rca_of_issue: The original bug ('let's go' -> 'didn't catch that') happened because the model had no control intent. It is fixed by the 'control' intent plus controls.apply_actions. Verified with and without ?speak=true and in the UI.
